notes.title: Richat Structure Announcement
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce our upcoming game — Richat Structure, a strategic excavation simulator set in one of the most mysterious places on Earth. 

You’re leading a scientific expedition to the Richat Structure — a colossal, ring-shaped formation in the heart of the Sahara Desert. Visible from orbit, studied by scientists, and speculated on by conspiracy theorists, this place has never been properly explored. Until now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596818/6c1a81516ce63845a3fd627e738d3ad80edac375.png[/img]

Construct underground bases, organize excavation sites, assign research teams and keep the lights running as you dig deeper into the unknown. Every layer reveals new resources, strange geological formations, and questions no textbook can answer. 

But the deeper you go, the stranger things get. 
 The crew starts changing. The data becomes harder to interpret. And the silence down there doesn’t feel empty. 

Start the expedition to the Richat Structure soon. Wishlist now and prepare to lead the mission, protect your team, and face the truths buried in the Earth’s oldest wound. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3693380/Richat_Structure/
